title: Part II · Section 03
subtitle: Where
introEn: Listen to each question and choose the best response (Where).

items.prompt: Where is the meeting being held?
Where should I put these shoes?

choices.A: At that new restaurant by the movie theater.

items.prompt: Where are we supposed to be meeting Helen?
Where are you going to leave your dog when you are on vacation?

choices.B: A friend of mine sold it to me.
choices.C: A friend of mine bought it from me.

items.prompt: Where did you get your new car from?

choices.B: I wanted to look nice for the party.
choices.C: My girlfriend bought it for me.

items.prompt: Where did you get that great shirt from?
